name: triggerBox
meaning: One box out of the model's own box list (model+0xc = {u32 count; CollBox[]}): box[1] when the object's facing +0x16 is non-zero, box[0] otherwise. The box DoorWorld_CustomCollide tests against. The count is read into a local and never used, so a single-box model with a non-zero facing points one rec

name: doorLevel
meaning: PROPERTY_DOORWORLD_IDDOORLEVEL (prop 4): the DoorLevel (class 170) this world-map door belongs to. Queried with msg 0x5900, whose 0/1/2 answer decides whether the door shows, hides or plays its opening sequence. Never NULL-checked before the two vtable calls.

name: openCamera
meaning: PROPERTY_DOORWORLD_CAMERAOPEN (prop 0) via Scn_GetPropCamera: the camera setup record played while the door opens, read as focal +0, pitch +2, yaw +4, roll +6 and Vec3s eye +8 straight into Camera_StartScripted.

name: timer
meaning: Millisecond accumulator used twice: state 3 waits past 1000 ms before starting the open animation, state 5 waits another 1000 ms before reporting back. Added as a signed word and zeroed on entry to each wait.

name: useOpenSequence
meaning: 1 when the open request arrived and the door has an openCamera, so states 2-5 play the full camera plus animation sequence; 0 makes state 4 skip waiting for the animation. Cleared by Reset and at the end of state 5.

name: state
meaning: 0 decide from the DoorLevel answer, 1 inert, 2 start the open camera, 3 wait 1 s then play anim 1, 4 wait for the anim then hide, 5 wait 1 s then notify the panel and go to SCN_UPD_NEVER (it stays in 5), 6 show and play anim 3.
